# Diana Barry

## Overview

- **Age:** About Anne's age  <sub>[v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037)</sub>
- **Origin:** Orchard Slope  <sub>[v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c17 P29](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0029), [v1 c26 P3](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0003)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Di  <sub>[v1 c18 P25](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0025)</sub>

## Appearance

Diana is a very pretty little girl with black hair, black eyes, and rosy cheeks inherited from her parents. She has a merry expression that she inherited from her father. Mrs. Rachel Lynde considers her to have snap and color in her looks.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043)_

## Personality

Diana is described as good, smart, and a very nice girl. She loves reading books to the point of poring over them constantly, aided and abetted by her father. She is affectionate and loyal to her friends, though she can get nervous and scared during emergencies.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022), [v1 c17 P29](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0029), [v1 c18 P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021)_

## Traits

- Good and smart  <sub>[v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040)</sub>
- Fond of reading  <sub>[v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022)</sub>

## Abilities

- Making red tissue paper bookmarkers  <sub>[v1 c17 P29](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0029)</sub>

## History

Diana lived at Orchard Slope and visited her aunt in Carmody before meeting Anne Shirley. Upon meeting Anne, the two swore a solemn oath of faithful bosom friendship. When her younger sister Minnie May fell severely ill with croup while their parents were away, a frightened Diana ran to fetch Anne, who managed to treat the illness. Later, when the Queen's class was organized at school, Diana did not join because her parents did not intend to send her to Queen's College, forcing her to walk home alone while Anne stayed for extra lessons. During the following summer vacation, Diana spent her days enjoying the outdoors with Anne around Lover's Lane, Willowmere, and Victoria Island.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c18 P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 c18 P25](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0025), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c31 P0](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0000)_

They are awfully fashionable now and only three girls in school know how to make them. When you look at it remember  <sub>[v1 c17 P29](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0029)</sub>
